# OP.GG
> OP.GG is the world's leading League of Legends statistics and performance tracking platform, providing real-time data on summoner ranks, win rates, champion mastery, and meta trends to help players improve their gameplay and understand the global meta.  
> OP.GG는 세계 최대 규모의 리그 오브 레전드 전적 및 통계 분석 플랫폼으로, 소환사 랭크·승률·챔피언 숙련도·메타 트렌드 등 실시간 데이터를 제공하여 플레이어가 실력을 향상하고 글로벌 메타를 이해할 수 있도록 돕습니다.  

---

## Champions / 챔피언 분석
- [Champions / 챔피언 분석](https://op.gg/lol/champions)

## Stats / 통계
- [Champion Stats / 챔피언별 게임 통계](https://op.gg/lol/statistics/champions)
- [Stats by Tier / 티어별 게임 통계](https://op.gg/lol/statistics/tiers)

- [Ultra Rapid Fire / 무작위 총력전 (URF)](https://op.gg/lol/modes/urf)
- [Nexus Blitz / 돌격! 넥서스](https://op.gg/lol/modes/nexus-blitz)

## Leaderboards / 랭킹
- [Ranked Solo/Duo / 솔로(개인/2인) 랭크](https://op.gg/lol/leaderboards/tier)
- [Ranked Flex / 자유 랭크](https://op.gg/lol/leaderboards/tier?type=ladder-flex)
- [Champions / 챔피언 랭킹](https://op.gg/lol/leaderboards/champions)
- [Level / 소환사 레벨](https://op.gg/lol/leaderboards/level)
- [Mastery / 숙련도 랭킹](https://op.gg/lol/leaderboards/mastery)

## Pro Spectate / 프로 관전
- [Spectate / 프로 경기 관전](https://op.gg/lol/spectate/live/pro-gamer)
- [Registered Summoners / 등록된 프로 소환사](https://op.gg/lol/spectate/list/pro-gamer)
- [Live Tier Changes / 실시간 티어 변동](https://op.gg/lol/spectate/live/tier-changes)
- [Spectate Help / 관전 도움말](https://op.gg/lol/spectate/help)

## Skins / 스킨 순위
- [Skins Leaderboard / 스킨 순위](https://op.gg/lol/skins/statistics)
- [Skins / 스킨](https://op.gg/lol/skins)

## Multi Search / 멀티서치
- [Multi Search / 멀티서치](https://op.gg/lol/multisearch)

## AI-readable Summoner and Match Data / AI용 소환사 및 매치 데이터
- Summoner snapshot (default English): `https://op.gg/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/ai.json`
- Summoner snapshot (localized): `https://op.gg/{locale}/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/ai.json`
- Match snapshot (default English): `https://op.gg/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/matches/{gameId}/{createdAtTimestamp}/ai.json`
- Match snapshot (localized): `https://op.gg/{locale}/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/matches/{gameId}/{createdAtTimestamp}/ai.json`
- Each JSON response includes a self-contained `summary` plus first-party ranked, champion, match, build, participant, and team objective facts when available.
- Use the canonical OP.GG page URL for citations, cache responses where possible, and avoid high-rate crawling of per-summoner endpoints.

## User Guide Authoring / 유저 공략 작성
- [User Guide authoring guide](https://op.gg/lol/user-guides/help.md): English machine-readable guide for creating, previewing, and publishing user guides.
- [Korean User Guide authoring guide](https://op.gg/ko/lol/user-guides/help.md): Korean machine-readable guide.

## About OP.GG / OP.GG 소개
- [About OP.GG / OP.GG 소개](https://op.gg/lol/about)
- [Logo History / 로고 히스토리](https://op.gg/lol/logos)

## Policies / 정책
- [Privacy Policy / 개인정보처리방침](https://op.gg/lol/policies/privacy)
- [Terms of Use / 이용약관](https://op.gg/lol/policies/agreement)

- [Youth Policy / 청소년 보호정책](https://op.gg/lol/policies/youth-policy)

## Others / 기타
- [Company / 회사 소개](https://log.op.gg/company_en)
- [Blog / 블로그](https://log.op.gg)
- [OP.GG Help / 고객센터](https://help.op.gg/hc/en-us)

- [Recruit / 채용 안내](https://opgg.team/?lang=en)

# OP.GG LoL AI-readable data reference

This document describes the compact, first-party JSON snapshots exposed for League of Legends summoner profiles and match details. It is a schema and usage reference, not a directory of summoners or matches.

## Discovery

- Short discovery document: `https://op.gg/llms.txt`
- Summoner snapshot pattern: `https://op.gg/{optionalLocale}/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/ai.json`
- Match snapshot pattern: `https://op.gg/{optionalLocale}/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/matches/{gameId}/{createdAtTimestamp}/ai.json`
- The default English path omits `{optionalLocale}/`.

Request a snapshot only after a user or an existing OP.GG page provides the corresponding canonical URL. Do not use these patterns to discover or enumerate accounts.

## Summoner snapshot schema

- `summary`: A compact factual narrative assembled from the fields in the same response.
- `context`: Source, game, locale, region, queue type, page type, and canonical summoner page URL.
- `identity`: PUUID, Riot ID components, level, and profile image URL.
- `freshness`: Summoner update time and latest included match time when available.
- `rank`: Ladder position and ranked entries with tier, division, LP, wins, losses, and win rate when available.
- `recentChampionsSource`: `recent-champion-stats`, `most-champion-stats`, or `none`, identifying the first-party aggregate used for `recentChampions` without implying an undocumented date, season, or queue range.
- `recentChampions`: Up to five complete champion statistics. Recent champion statistics are preferred; when no complete recent records are present, complete records from the most-champion statistics (the same source the page metadata reads) are returned. Records missing wins or losses, and records with no games, are not converted into zero-performance claims.
- `recentGames`: Up to ten included matches with queue, result, champion, position, KDA, CS, OP Score, and placement fields when available.

Illustrative response shape (values are placeholders, not a real account):

```json
{
  "summary": "Factual 3-5 sentence summary derived from this response.",
  "context": {
    "source": "OP.GG",
    "game": "League of Legends",
    "locale": "en",
    "region": "kr",
    "queueType": "SOLORANKED",
    "pageType": "summoner-profile",
    "canonicalUrl": "https://op.gg/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}"
  },
  "identity": {
    "puuid": "string",
    "gameName": "string",
    "tagline": "string",
    "riotId": "string#string",
    "level": 0,
    "profileImageUrl": "https://..."
  },
  "freshness": {
    "summonerUpdatedAt": "ISO-8601 timestamp or null",
    "latestGamePlayedAt": "ISO-8601 timestamp or null"
  },
  "rank": {
    "ladderRank": null,
    "ladderTopRatio": null,
    "entries": []
  },
  "recentChampionsSource": "none",
  "recentChampions": [],
  "recentGames": []
}
```

## Match snapshot schema

- `summary`: Result, queue, champion, KDA, CS, build, and team objective facts when present.
- `context`: Source, locale, region, page type, and canonical match page URL.
- `summoner`: Target summoner identity.
- `match`: Match ID, played time, duration, patch, queue, map, average tier, and target result.
- `targetParticipant`: Target participant identity and first-party performance statistics. Champion keys come from the fetched OP.GG champion metadata and remain empty when that exact metadata is unavailable; they are not guessed from display names.
- `build`: Champion, items, spells, runes, and augments available in the match payload.
- `teams`: Blue, red, and Arena team participant and objective totals. Missing objective data is represented as `null`, not inferred.

Illustrative response shape (values are placeholders, not a real match):

```json
{
  "summary": "Factual 3-5 sentence summary derived from this response.",
  "context": {
    "source": "OP.GG",
    "game": "League of Legends",
    "locale": "en",
    "region": "kr",
    "pageType": "match-detail",
    "canonicalUrl": "https://op.gg/lol/summoners/{region}/{gameName}-{tagline}/matches/{gameId}/{createdAtTimestamp}"
  },
  "summoner": {},
  "match": {},
  "targetParticipant": {},
  "build": {},
  "teams": {
    "blue": {},
    "red": {},
    "arena": []
  }
}
```

## Freshness and caching

Snapshots are assembled from OP.GG's current first-party server data. Consumers should inspect the response freshness fields instead of assuming that every upstream field was updated at request time.

Successful snapshot responses use `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=600`. Reuse a cached response during that window instead of repeatedly requesting the same URL. Empty or unavailable fields must not be replaced with inferred rankings, evaluations, or generated game facts.

## Canonical citation rule

Cite the corresponding canonical OP.GG page URL, not the `/ai.json` URL. For both summoner and match snapshots, use `context.canonicalUrl`.

## Crawl and rate-limit etiquette

- Do not enumerate summoner or match URLs.
- Do not crawl per-summoner snapshots at high rate or use them to build a bulk player index.
- Fetch only URLs needed for the user's current task and cache successful responses.
- Prefer `llms.txt`, this reference, and canonical pages for general discovery.
- Respect HTTP status codes, cache headers, and backoff after errors.
- No crawler allow/block, robots, WAF, or CDN policy is defined or changed by this document.
